name: Csc.EXE Execution Form Potentially Suspicious Parent
description: Detects a potentially suspicious parent of "csc.exe", which could be a sign of payload delivery.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\csc.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:csc.exe) AND ((process.parent.executable:(*\\cscript.exe OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\onenote.exe OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\winword.exe OR *\\wscript.exe)) OR ((process.parent.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe)) AND (process.parent.command_line:(*\-Encoded\ * OR *FromBase64String*))) OR (process.parent.command_line:/([Pp]rogram[Dd]ata|%([Ll]ocal)?[Aa]pp[Dd]ata%|\\[Aa]pp[Dd]ata\\([Ll]ocal([Ll]ow)?|[Rr]oaming))\\[^\\]{1,256}$/ OR (process.parent.command_line:(*\:\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\:\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\Temporary\ Internet*)) OR (process.parent.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.parent.command_line:*\\Favorites\\*) OR (process.parent.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.parent.command_line:*\\Favourites\\*) OR (process.parent.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.parent.command_line:*\\Contacts\\*) OR (process.parent.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.parent.command_line:*\\Pictures\\*))) AND (NOT ((process.parent.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\\*)) OR (process.parent.executable:C\:\\ProgramData\\chocolatey\\choco.exe OR process.parent.command_line:*\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows\ Defender\ Advanced\ Threat\ Protection* OR
